_comment: Epic 12 — equipment-tier loot. Flat, small, permanent stat bumps (+1/+2). Deliberately unglamorous per 01_VISION.md's tone ceiling — no magic-shop language, no rarity tiers. One item equips at a time (RealisticPatron.equipped_item on the adventurer dict), silently replacing whatever was there before.

dented_shield.description: Stopped one blade too many. Still holds.

worn_travel_boots.description: Walked farther than their owner cared to.

sharpening_stone.description: Keeps an edge true. Nothing more, nothing less.

tattered_spellbook.description: Half the pages are illegible. The half that isn't, matters.

lucky_coin_pouch.description: Worn smooth from being turned over and over in someone's pocket.

campfire_cloak.description: Smells of woodsmoke no matter how many times it's washed.

soldiers_bracer.description: Standard-issue, decades old. Someone else wore it first.

herbalists_satchel.description: Smells of dried leaves and old bandages.
